title: At the Train Station
introduction: مکالمه را با صدای بلند بخوان. عبارت‌های پرسیدن ساعت و خرید بلیت را تمرین کن.
paragraphs: Passenger: Excuse me. What time is the next train to Oxford?
Staff: It leaves at ten thirty.
Passenger: Can I buy a ticket here?
Staff: Yes, of course. One way or return?
Passenger: A one-way ticket, please. How much is it?
Passenger: Here you are. Thank you.
Staff: You’re welcome. Have a good trip!
